description: We sincerely appreciate the dedication of the firefighters and rescue teams who are working tirelessly day and night to contain the wildfires. We truly hope that the wildfires will be brought under control as soon as possible.

descriptionI18n.ko: 산불 진화를 위해 밤낮으로 애쓰시는 대한민국 소방관, 구조대 여러 분들을 댓글로 응원해 주세요. 하루 빨리 산불이 진화 되기를 진심으로 기원합니다.
descriptionI18n.en: We sincerely appreciate the dedication of the firefighters and rescue teams who are working tirelessly day and night to contain the wildfires. We truly hope that the wildfires will be brought under control as soon as possible.
descriptionI18n.ja: 昼夜を問わず、森林火災の鎮火に尽力されている消防士の方々や救助隊の皆様のご尽力に心より感謝申し上げます。一日も早く森林火災が鎮火することを心よりお祈り申し上げます。
